newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.16 down at 41.85 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday amid higher demand of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday on fresh demand of the U.S. currency, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 3.20 percent.
